summary: This note covers the seventh and final season of the American television drama Scandal. ABC ordered the season on February 10, 2017, and it was announced as the show's last season. The season premiered October 5, 2017, with 18 episodes, bringing the series total to 124, and was produced by ABC Studios with ShondaLand Production Company under showrunner Shonda Rhimes.
one_line: Overview of the seventh and final season of the ABC drama Scandal, ordered in 2017 and premiering October 5, 2017.
key_facts: The seventh and final season of the American television drama series Scandal was ordered on February 10, 2017 by ABC.
It was later announced that the seventh season of Scandal would be the final season for the show.
The seventh season of Scandal began airing on October 5, 2017.
The seventh season of Scandal consists of 18 episodes.
The 18 episodes of season seven bring the total episode count of Scandal to 124 episodes.
Cast member George Newbern was upgraded to a series regular in Scandal season seven.
George Newbern had been a recurring cast member of Scandal for the past six seasons before his upgrade.
The seventh season of Scandal is produced by ABC Studios.
The seventh season of Scandal is produced in association with ShondaLand Production Company.
The showrunner of Scandal's seventh season is Shonda Rhimes.
